summary: Phase 1 Website Claims Correction passes Review-A after a blocking finding (stale 'launching in 2025' dates in Science Advantage and CodeCamp Advantage openGraph metadata, missed by the initial test which only scanned locale files) was identified and fixed in commit 940420a0. All 20 phase-w3-claims tests pass, lint and check-types are clean, and all Tier 1 banned literals are verified absent from the www source. Positive controls confirm truthful replacements exist in each group (1A–1I). The Wave 2 reusable helper shows no regression.
nonblocking_findings: NB-1: The '3x faster' claim (CC-25) used a Unicode multiplication sign (×) in source, making the regex /3×/g match the exact character. If the claim is ever re-added with a plain ASCII 'x', the test would not catch it. Low risk since the math page is now roadmap-labeled and the stat was removed.

NB-2: The b2b-solutions.ts 'New for SY2025' badge (CC-11 scope) was not covered by the phase-w3-claims test because b2b-solutions.ts is under locales/components/, not locales/pages/products/. Fixed in commit 80231438 but test coverage is absent for this specific file.
